description: A brushed-steel plaque the size of a hymn board, bearing the open eye and, beneath it, COMPLIANT PLACE OF WORSHIP · IX. It is fitted across the lower line of the lintel carving and covers it precisely. The screw heads are burred and the holes have gone oval, which is what happens to a fixing that has been driven and backed out several hundred times. Behind the edges, where the weather never gets, the sandstone is noticeably cleaner.
name: Architect plaque
